newsitem.title: JAPAN: Current yen rate won't affect prices--BOJ official.
newsitem.headline: Current yen rate won't affect prices--BOJ official.

text.p: The yen's recent depreciation against the dollar is unlikely to have a major impact on prices, a senior Bank of Japan official said on Tuesday.

"Given that in many cases there presently exists a price differential between Japan and overseas, even if the yen depreciates, there is no particular worry about the impact on prices," a senior BOJ official told Reuters.
He said that because the price differential was so great in some cases, a rise in import prices would not drive up overall domestic prices by that much.
But the official said the central bank would meet with corporations to see whether the yen's depreciation will halt the shrinking of the trade surplus.
"We are still unsure whether the current (dollar/yen exchange) rate will affect corporate trade activities and influence the current account," the official said.
